issues.description: The problem statement and tasks refer to a server-side method named createPerson to implement the POST /persons endpoint, but the reference solution implements this endpoint method as addPerson in PersonResource. This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual action (creating/saving a Person) can confuse students who search for or expect a createPerson method (and who see createNote used for notes), making it harder to map the task instructions to the provided solution/template.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent method name for the POST /persons endpoint across all artifacts. Rename the solution method addPerson to createPerson (or update the problem statement to reference addPerson). Preferably align with NoteResource naming by renaming addPerson -> createPerson in PersonResource so problem text, template, and solution use the same identifier.
